{{Top|leg}}
An '''inciter''' was a device which jump-started a [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder's]] motor by sliding the device under the speeder's readout panel. In [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], the [[Mistryl Shadow Guard]] [[Karoly D'ulin]] used a Mistryl-issue inciter to commandeer several landspeeders while following [[Zothip|Captain Zothip]] of the [[Cavrilhu Pirates]] on [[Bastion/Legends|Bastion]], including a heavily damaged [[9000 Z001 landspeeder/Legends|Ubrikkian 9000]] and a [[Slipter]].
